newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak money mkt rates on hold, await auction Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak money mkt rates on hold, await auction Wed.

text.p: Slovak interbank money market rates continued to firm on Tuesday, eventually settling within a 14.1-15.8 percent offer range on all terms, descending the yield curve.
Dealers said the rise continued on speculative overnight trading in the morning ahead of Wednesday's Finance Ministry 39-week T-bill auction.
"The market has steadied in the afternoon on expectations of a T-bill auction result, and the central bank steps that would follow it," Peter Sandor, a Polnobanka dealer, said.
